title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of a vintage‑style set featuring ripping Schoolgirl, New Speedway and a standout Speedway Boogie, though Cold Jordan is missed.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy – the band plays hard through the closing "Lovelight," delivers an exceptional version of "Speedway Boogie" with the infamous “nobody’s fault” jam, and rip‑off renditions of "Schoolgirl," "New Speedway" and the "China > Rider" sequence. Recording quality is not specifically mentioned but the SBD source suggests a clear, well‑mixed capture; the only noted drawback is the absence of a hoped‑for "Cold Jordan."

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic reviews (average 4.7 stars) highlight many standout performances and no recording complaints, indicating a strong show with good technical capture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific audio issues mentioned; SBD source implies clear, balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic first half leading into a hard‑driving close on "Lovelight"; second set highlighted by tight jams and vintage vibes.
